items.title: Show HN: SqlFlow – Durable Workflows Backed by PostgreSQL or SQL Server
items.contentSnippet:
Hey HN!
I have built SqlFlow, which is an open-source durable workflow engine backed by PostgreSQL or SQL Server, with SDKs for .NET, Java, Python, and Go. Workflows support retries, checkpoints, rate limitng, scheduling, and suspension while waiting for events.
It took a large deal of inspiration from Absurd, but it expands on the core concepts.

items.title: Show HN: Check how readable your docs are to AI agents
items.contentSnippet:
Hi HN, I'm Aravind. We build Velu, a docs platform.
Coding agents increasingly read docs before humans do, but most docs
sites are hard for them: client-rendered pages, no llms.txt, no
markdown versions, soft 404s, pages too big for a context window.
This tool scores any docs URL against the open Agent-Friendly
Documentation Spec (agentdocsspec.com), using its 
reference implementation, afdocs.
Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50030369
